fl1846.line: A map of the new State of Florida, made by U.S. Army mapmakers in 1846, one year after Florida became a state. Library of Congress. Free to use.

kingsley.line: A real place: the slave quarters (the cabins where enslaved people lived) at Kingsley Plantation on Fort George Island, near Jacksonville. Built about 1822 to 1830. Photo: Historic American Buildings Survey, Library of Congress. Free to use.
